summary: Nomad Foods Ltd filed a Form 6-K amending and supplementing its definitive proxy statement for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 22, 2026. The supplemental disclosures update board and committee meeting attendance rates for fiscal 2025, now stating 96% average attendance. No material corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is disclosed; the filing is a routine meeting-related supplement. The Form 6-K also incorporates by reference earlier registration statements. As a non-US filing equivalent to a proxy supplement, it does not trigger any special-situation classification.
